messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to match the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks forward away from the camera, then turns and sways her hips and arms in a dance-like motion.","camera":"A medium full-body shot from behind, with the camera slowly moving closer and tilting slightly as the character moves.","clothing":"She wears a short, blue-and-white patterned romper with a deep open back and three-quarter sleeves, plus light-colored flat shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is styled into two high buns on either side of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen from behind.","scene":"A cobblestone city street lined with red-brick buildings, shop awnings, and vintage street lamps under a bright, hazy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now walks forward away from the camera and then performs a dance-like motion with hip and arm movement, similar to the reference's walking and swaying action. The blue-haired character, blue-and-white romper, cobblestone street, and rear camera framing remain largely consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the motion reference, transferring only the demonstrated action while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the dance motion precisely matches the reference's specific arm and hip movements, since the reference is a different character and scene.
unexpected_changes: The character's clothing appears slightly different in some frames, resembling a romper/shorts rather than the source dress, though the pattern and color remain similar.
The camera framing is tighter and more consistently from behind than in the source, where the character was initially seen in profile.
